text:
alex: quick idea — we need a lightweight way to surface per-tenant inference cost before heavy enrichment so billing can react without blowing up cardinality.
jun: +1. main concern is cardinality from model+quant+route tags. coarse buckets could help.
sara: what do you mean by buckets? token ranges or cost ranges?
alex: cost ranges. gateway estimates tokens/request and model-selection weight -> map to bucket. e.g. cost_bucket: [tiny, small, medium, large]. very low cardinality.
matt: how do we keep accuracy? we currently need fine-grained cost for chargeback dashboards.
alex: keep full estimator in downstream enrichment for offline accuracy. realtime path only needs rough signal for throttling/alerts and cost-aware routing. downstream jobs can retro-fit exact costs.
nora: two operational q's: 1) who owns the gateway estimator? 2) how do we avoid flapping when model selection changes mid-request?
jun: ownership: infra/gateway team owns the estimator; enrichment still owned by obs-platform. contract: gateway emits telemetry.header.cost_bucket and telemetry.header.cost_sample_id.
sara: cost_sample_id for sampling linkage — ok. for flapping: add hysteresis on model-switch decisions (i.e. keep previous bucket for N seconds) and a fallback tag if model picks change after response.
matt: need to formalize sampler behavior: gateway does probabilistic sampling for high-cardinality attributes and stamps sample_id. downstream processing joins sampled full-cost traces by sample_id.
obs-bot: deploy pipeline: gateway-estimator v1 -> canary 10% in eu-west1 at 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z.
alex: sketch of contract (minimal):
```
{
  "telemetry.header.cost_bucket": "string (tiny|small|medium|large)",
  "telemetry.header.tokens_est": "int",
  "telemetry.header.cost_sample_id": "uuid | null"
}
```
jun: we also need an enum mapping doc that ties bucket->estimated price range and how we compute tokens_est (header token_count vs model heuristics).
nora: what about retention? if gateway only emits bucket, we might keep that in realtime metrics for 90d and full-cost joins for 365d. keeps metrics storage sane.
sara: risk: product teams may think bucket == exact charge. we need clear docs and a slow-roll opt-in for teams that want exact realtime billing.
matt: ops: when sampler drops a lot of samples, our offline estimator needs to account for sampling bias. include sampling rate in enrichment metadata.
jun: also consider a delta tag for requests that triggered fallback routing (e.g., ran out of capacity and used cheaper model) — that affects cost attribution.
alex: good call. add telemetry.header.fallback_model = "string|null" for strict accounting. low-cardinality (just model name or 'none').
obs-bot: note: created proposal PR #823 in eng-platform/telemetry-contracts.
sara: next steps: alex to author RFC-ish note with concrete estimator pseudo-code and API contract; matt to draft sampling bias adjustments for aggregator; jun to draft gateway canary plan.
alex: will post RFC by EOD Friday. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
